content.short: Proof of Play RNG is a verifiable on-chain random number generation service for smart contracts.
content.description: Proof of Play RNG provides verifiable randomness to smart contracts, the primitive that games, lotteries and any mechanic involving chance depend on. On-chain randomness is a genuinely hard problem, since block data that looks random can be influenced by whoever produces the block, so contracts need a source they can verify rather than trust. Hyperliquid's builder documentation lists it under smart contract tooling for the network.
